dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Menyenangkan sekali! Hari Sabtu aku mengunjungi kakek dan nenekku.
dialogue.en: It was great! On Saturday I visited my grandparents.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Wah, bagus! Apa yang kalian lakukan di sana?
dialogue.en: Nice! What did you do there?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Kami memasak makan siang besar bersama, lalu menonton film.
dialogue.en: We cooked a big lunch together, and then we watched a movie.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Kedengarannya menyenangkan. Bagaimana dengan hari Minggu?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Aku lelah, jadi aku beristirahat di rumah seharian.
dialogue.en: I was tired, so I rested at home all day.
